free_tier_limits.correction: Free users receive 1,000 Hub API requests, 5,000 resolver requests, and 200 page requests per 5-minute fixed window. These limits may change with platform health.

rate_limits.correction: Main rate limits are published by plan and use 5-minute fixed windows. Anonymous users receive 500 API requests; Free 1,000; PRO 2,500; Team 3,000; Enterprise 6,000; and Enterprise Plus 10,000. Separate resolver and page quotas also apply. Some granular action limits remain unpublished.

notes: The API and example endpoint are operational; the example's legacy model ID redirects to google-bert/bert-base-uncased. Hugging Face moved its detailed endpoint reference to a live OpenAPI specification. The entry fails because exact plan-based rate limits are now published, making both rate-limit claims stale. No current official CORS policy was located.
